body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #9, company drawn at random (seed 20261206) from Information Technology / Healthcare names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.75 (naive base rate 0.6) that: Viyash Scientific promoter and promoter-group holding is >= 45.0% in the shareholding pattern for 31-Mar-2027. Our reasoning: Promoter 61.31% (Jun-2026) -> 49.24% (Sep-2026) after a ~12% block; MD on the 14-Nov-2026 call: 'next 12 months, I don't see anything'. Naive base: [EST] a PE promoter in year 5-6 that just sold 12%; no measured base rate (0.60). Resolution: YES if NSE pledge-data percPromoterHolding for SHP 31-Mar-2027 is >= 45.0. Source: NSE corporate pledge data API (SHP 31-Mar-2027). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
